cases.note: §80's third state, decided 2026-09-07. The body declares a person detector and the operator configured separation, so every input the resolver can see is present — and nothing on this robot fills `cycle.nearest_person_m`. The guard is therefore neither active nor unavailable: it is *inert*, and the reading it waits on is named. Before this state existed it resolved **active**, which is what every surface renders as protection.
